value.title: Dependabot scope note: teaching guide disarmed; not dispatch-ready

value.principles: Use native Dependabot configuration and the existing pull_request workflow. The unrelated text-conversion teaching scaffold is explicitly disarmed; this source note is not an approved Builder implementation guide.
value.composition_root: .github/dependabot.yml is consumed by GitHub on the default branch; proposed bot PRs use the unchanged .github/workflows/rust.yml.
contracts: version: 2; cargo and github-actions each at /; weekly; version-update PR caps 5 and 2 respectively.
No product/dependency/action upgrades, bot privilege exceptions, npm ecosystem, secrets or automatic merge.

value.rationale: One small configuration contract has no independently runnable sub-units. Main owns integration and validation; this worker was directly assigned a source-only edit, not formally dispatched through Builder.

value.note: Use only the already allocated builder/016-dependabot-ci worktree. No coder allocation, native rebind or baseline sealing is claimed.

steps: Review the source-ready configuration and DD note, then run the suggested local validation once after concurrent deliveries.
Only separately authorized default-branch integration can activate Dependabot; inspect real update-job logs and bot-PR CI after that integration.

value.when: Main validates this source-ready change after the concurrent batch. Formal guide checking, baseline sealing and independent decomposition review have not occurred.
